title: Link scopes for variables
description: This symbol table uses linked scopes so lookup and update can walk outward through enclosing blocks.

steps.description: Var holds one name-value pair and a next pointer. Scope holds a list of variables and a parent scope. current starts at global.
push_scope creates a scope whose parent is current. pop_scope moves current back to its parent.
find searches one scope. define_var adds a name to the current scope only.
set_var and get_var walk from current through parent scopes, stopping at the first matching name.
